title: Comparatives
definition: The comparative form compares two people, things, or actions. Many German adjectives form the comparative by adding -er; some common adjectives are irregular or take an umlaut.

rules.title: Regular comparative: adjective + -er
rules.explanation: Add -er to many adjectives. Use als to introduce the second item in a comparison.

examples.german: Mein Bruder ist größer als ich.
examples.english: My brother is taller than me.

examples.german: Der Zug ist schneller als der Bus.
examples.english: The train is faster than the bus.

examples.german: Dieses Buch ist interessanter als das andere.
examples.english: This book is more interesting than the other one.

rules.title: Comparatives with umlaut
rules.explanation: Some short adjectives with a, o, or u take an umlaut in the comparative.

rules.title: Use als, not wie, for unequal comparisons
rules.explanation: Use größer als for 'bigger than'. Gleichheit uses so ... wie or genauso ... wie.

examples.german: Er ist so groß wie sein Bruder.
examples.english: He is as tall as his brother.

examples.german: Das Auto ist genauso teuer wie das andere.
examples.english: The car is just as expensive as the other one.

common_mistakes.wrong: Mein Auto ist schneller wie dein Auto.
common_mistakes.correct: Mein Auto ist schneller als dein Auto.

mastery_goal: You can form common comparatives and compare people or things using als and so ... wie.
